The '''Geharran city continent''' was a landmass located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Geharr]] was located on the continent.<ref name="Strongholds" />
